```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

INDIR = 'Q:/Model Research/AV_Resource_Portal/vizdata'

crash_bubble_color = '#c1121f'

lavender_map = {
    'No Injuries Reported':'#f5e6e8',
    'Minor':'#d5c6e0',
    'Moderate':'#aaa1c8',
    'Serious':'#967aa1',
    'Fatality':'#192a51',
    'Unknown':'#eff1ed',
}

injury_severity_map = {
    'No Injuries Reported':'#e6e6e6',
    'Minor':'#ffb095',
    'Moderate':'#ff6d66',
    'Serious':'#c41d4a',
    'Fatality':'#720006',
    'Unknown':'#e6e6e6',
}

all_others_combined_bgcolor='#e6e6e6'
all_others_combined_fgcolor='#747373'
unknown_inj_hash_color = '#c41d4a'


crash = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crashes.csv')
crash_state = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_state.csv')
crash_city = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_city_top10.csv')
crash_sf_sev = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_sf_sev.csv')
crash_sf_comp = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_sf_comp.csv')
crash_ca_comp_sev = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_ca_comp_sev.csv')
crash_geo_sev = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_geo_sev.csv')
crash_geo_comp = pd.read_csv(Path(INDIR) / 'crash_geo_comp.csv')

# fix data type, needs to be str for discrete_color_map
crash_state['San Francisco'] = crash_state['San Francisco'].astype(str)
severity_order = ['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']
comp_crashtot_descending = crash.groupby('Company').size().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
```

::: {.callout-important}
The publicly available data used in the AV Resource Portal Data Dashboard limits the analysis and information presented due to the design of the data reports and redactions made by AV companies under confidential business information claims. Please see [Transparency](.\data_dashboard\transparency.html) for more information.

Safety analysis uses collision rates, often specified as incidents per million or hundred-million miles, to track trends over time and to make comparisons between different modes, cities, times of day, or other factors. Data limitations prevent aligning collisions and mileage, or even from knowing the total mileage of any AV company's fleet, and as a consequence prevent showing collision rates. 
:::

This section presents collision data from the National Highway Transportation Safety Administration (NHTSA) [Standing General Order 2021-01 (SGO)](https://www.nhtsa.gov/laws-regulations/standing-general-order-crash-reporting).  

## Crashes in the US

```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-severity
#| fig-cap: "Crash Severity"

fig1 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_sev,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#c1121f'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=severity_order,
    
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_sev[severity].to_numpy()}],
                    label=severity,
                    method="restyle",
                ) for severity in ['Total'] + severity_order
            ]),
            bgcolor=None,
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top"
        ),
    ]
)

fig1.show()
```

::: {.column-margin}
AV crashes are reported throughout the country, but the largest single concentration is in San Francisco. Most result in no injury, but there are cases of injuries and fatalities.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-company
#| fig-cap: "Crashes by Company"

fig2 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_comp,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#003049'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=comp_crashtot_descending[:5],
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_comp[company].to_numpy()}],
                    label=company,
                    method="restyle"
                ) for company in ['Total'] + comp_crashtot_descending 
            ]),
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top",
        ),
    ]
)


fig2.show()

```

::: {.column-margin}
Waymo has more collisions than any other AV company, but numerous AV companies are involved in collisions across the country.
:::


```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-state
#| fig-cap: "Crashes by State"

fig3 = px.bar(
    crash_state.loc[:,['State','San Francisco','Crashes']], 
    x='State', 
    y='Crashes', 
    color='San Francisco',
    color_discrete_map={
        '0':'#dbddde',
        '1':'#ff6d66'
    }
)

fig3.update_layout(
    showlegend=False,
    yaxis_title=None,
    xaxis_title=None,
)

ca = crash_state[crash_state['State'] == 'CA'].copy()
bottom = 100

for _, row in ca.iterrows():
    fig3.add_annotation(
        dict(
            x=0.5,
            y=bottom + row['Crashes'] / 2,
            ax=100,
            ay=-10 if row['San Francisco'] == '0' else None,
            text='San Francisco' if row['San Francisco'] == '1'
                 else 'Rest of California',
            showarrow=True,
            arrowhead=2, #4
            arrowwidth=2,
            font=dict(color='#ff5c55' if row['San Francisco'] == '1'
                else '#aaaaaa',
                weight='bold'
                ),
            arrowcolor='#ff5c55' if row['San Francisco'] == '1'
                else '#aaaaaa',
        )
    )
    bottom += (row['Crashes'] - 100)

fig3.show()
```

::: {.column-margin}

San Francisco **alone** has more crashes than any the rest of California, or other state, despite having an area less than 50 square miles.

:::


```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-city
#| fig-cap: "Crashes by City"
#| cap-location: top

fig4 = px.pie(
    crash_city,
    names='City',
    values='Crashes',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#636efa','#b6baf0'] * (int(len(crash_city) / 2) +1)
)

fig4.update_layout(
    yaxis_title=None,
    xaxis_title=None,
)

fig4.update_traces(
    dict(marker_pattern_bgcolor=all_others_combined_bgcolor,
         marker_pattern_fgcolor=all_others_combined_fgcolor,
         marker_pattern_shape='/',
        ),
    selector=({'legendgroup':'All Others Combined'}),
)

fig4.show()
```

## Crashes in San Francisco

:::{.column-body} 
:::{.panel-tabset}

## San Francisco

```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-sf
#| fig-cap: "Crashes in San Francisco"
#| cap-location: top

crash_disp = (
    crash.loc[crash['City'].eq('San Francisco')]
    .groupby(['Company','Injury Severity'], as_index=False)
    .size()
    .sort_values(by='size',ascending=False)
    .rename(columns={'size':'Crashes'})
)


fig5 = px.bar(
    crash_disp,
    x='Company',
    y='Crashes',
    color='Injury Severity',
    color_discrete_map= injury_severity_map,
    category_orders = {'Injury Severity':['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']}
)

fig5.update_traces(
    dict(marker_pattern_fgcolor=unknown_inj_hash_color,
         marker_pattern_shape='/',
        ),
    selector=({'legendgroup':'Unknown'}),
)
fig5.show()
```

## California

```{python}
#| label: fig-crash-ca
#| fig-cap: "Crashes in California"
#| cap-location: top

crash_disp = (
    crash.loc[crash['State'].eq('CA')]
    .groupby(['Company','Injury Severity'], as_index=False)
    .size()
    .sort_values(by='size',ascending=False)
    .rename(columns={'size':'Crashes'})
)

top5 = crash_disp.groupby(['Company']).agg({'Crashes':'sum'}).sort_values(by=['Crashes'], ascending=False).index[0:5]

crash_disp.loc[~crash_disp['Company'].isin(top5), 'Company'] = "All Others"
crash_disp = (
    crash_disp.groupby(['Company','Injury Severity'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'Crashes':'sum'})
    .sort_values(by='Crashes',ascending=False)
)

fig7 = px.bar(
    crash_disp,
    x='Company',
    y='Crashes',
    color='Injury Severity',
    color_discrete_map= injury_severity_map,
    category_orders = {'Injury Severity':['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']}
)

fig7.update_traces(
    dict(marker_pattern_fgcolor=unknown_inj_hash_color,
         marker_pattern_shape='/',
         opacity=0.75
        ),
    selector=({'legendgroup':'Unkown'}),
)

fig7.show()
```

::: {.column-margin}
Most crashes result in no injury.  Waymo, the only company operating commercial AV passenger service under a deployment permit, has the most crashes.  Cruise, which also briefly operated commercial AV passenger service under a deployment permit, follows with the second-most number of crashes
:::
